Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for last week's demo. Our legal and security teams have a couple of gating items to fold into the MAP before we can commit to a pilot schedule. High level: SOC 2 evidence window, SIG/CAIQ self-assessment deliverable, DPA redline items (data residency and deletion SLA), and a clear retention schedule for inference logs and embeddings.

Can we align on a two-week evaluation run (POC) and a staged acceptance plan that maps each security gate to an ownership and due date? Procurement also asked for a tentative DPA timeline so they can budget the review.

Best,

Hi Alice —

Thanks, very actionable list. Quick proposal below for the MAP staging (we'll attach a one-page playbook and the SOC 2 scoping doc). I kept dates conservative so your internal reviewers have time to cycle. If Acme prefers tighter SLAs we can compress.

1) Week 0 (now → Day 5): Agreement on artifacts + DPA redline submission
   - Owner: Procurement (Acme) + Kimberly (Redwood legal support)
   - Deliverables: DPA redline v1, CAIQ questionnaire scope, list of datasets for POC

2) Week 1: SIG/CAIQ self-assessment (initial) + SOC 2 onboarding Qs
   - Owner: Security (Acme) + Jonas (Redwood compliance)
   - Deliverables: CAIQ draft answers, SOC 2 in-scope control mapping, high-level evidence schedule

3) Week 2: POC run + evidence snapshot collection
   - Owner: Acme POC lead + Redwood engs
   - Deliverables: sample logs (anonymized), access logs, prefix cache behavior notes

4) Week 3: Close decision window — acceptance or remediation list
   - Owner: Joint decision (Acme security + Redwood compliance)
   - Deliverables: Acceptance signoff or remediation plan (with owners and ETA)

Notes on data retention and deletion requests: Redwood can support per-customer retention windows for inference traces and embeddings. Typical options: 7 days (default), 30 days (recommended for evaluation), or custom contract term. We propose 30 days for the POC to allow meaningful metrics while minimizing exposure.

I'll attach the SOC2_scoping.pdf and a DPA_redline_v1 template. Kimberly will coordinate on the legal side — Kim, can you confirm we can accept a 30-day evaluation retention by default and highlight any carveouts?

Next steps:
- Alice: share procurement contact and preferred DPA review cadence
- Acme security: confirm CAIQ owner for the self-assessment
- Redwood: we will circulate the one-page MAP playbook and the SOC 2 scoping doc by EOD PT

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Confirming Redwood legal and compliance can accommodate a 30-day retention window for the POC, with a contract-level option to extend or tighten per Acme's risk posture. Two items for clarity:

- DPA redline: please send a single consolidated redline vs. the template (procurement@acme-analytics.com is fine). We'll scope residency (US regions) and deletion SLAs (30 days default, 48-hour expedited deletion for scoped test data on written request).

- SOC 2 evidence: we'll provide the control mapping and a snapshot of available artifacts. Full Type II reports are on our portal; for POC you'll get scoping plus access to sample evidence artifacts.

Soojin (security ops) — can you prepare the short CAIQ guidance note (what we will answer vs. what requires additional evidence) and a list of red flags we anticipate? Put it in the shared Drive link and ping Alice when ready.
